import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i,o=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
def solve(T):
    H,W=len(T),len(T[0])
    bg=T[0][0]
    # pattern bbox: cells not bg and not 0
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if T[r][c]!=bg and T[r][c]!=0]
    r0=min(p for p,_ in pts); c0=min(c for _,c in pts)
    p=[T[r][c0:c0+max(c for _,c in pts)-c0+1] for r,r0 in [(min(pr for pr,_ in pts),None)] ]
    # simpler: pattern block from original grid top-left of bbox
    maxc=max(c for _,c in pts); maxr=max(r for r,_ in pts)
    p=[[T[r][c] for c in range(c0,maxc+1)] for r in range(r0,maxr+1)]
    # zero rect
    zr=[r for r in range(H) if any(x==0 for x in T[r])]
    zc=[c for c in range(W) if any(T[r][c]==0 for r in zr)]
    z0,z1,c0_,c1_=min(zr),max(zr),min(zc),max(zc)
    o=[r[:] for r in T]
    for r in range(z0,z1+1):
        for c in range(c0_,c1_+1):
            o[r][c]=p[r-z0][c-c0_]
    return o
print(solve(i)==o)
out=solve(G['Test input']); print(json.dumps(out))
